revision.reason: S-6 C3 Defect 2: the per-task `acceptance_cmd` was PROSE ('npm test green AND added case: slugify(...) === ...'). The runner did `eval "$acc"` on it → the description is not a command → shell syntax error on the '(' → the working_output FAIL was a RUNNER error, not a real test result. eval-on-unsanitized-prose is itself a landmine-class pattern. (v2's SHA-pin + degenerate-task swaps + tightenings are PRESERVED here verbatim; this revision only fixes the acceptance shape.)
revision.fix: The single prose `acceptance_cmd` per task is REPLACED by TWO runnable fields: `baseline_cmd` (the repo's OWN test/build — the regression signal, e.g. `npm test`, `pip install -e . && pytest -q`, `go test ./...`, `cargo test`) and `assertion_cmd` (a real, self-contained one-liner verifying the TASK-SPECIFIC behavior the solution must produce; exit 0 = pass). The runner runs both as DEFINED manifest commands via `bash -c` (like a Makefile target), NEVER `eval` of free prose. working_output PASS = baseline_cmd exits 0 AND assertion_cmd exits 0; both exit codes + quoted output are captured as evidence. SHA pins, task_prompts, reused_symbols_expected, validation_at_sha, and interpretation bands are ALL unchanged.
revision.acceptance_schema: Per task: `baseline_cmd` (string — the repo's own green test/build, run first as the regression signal) + `assertion_cmd` (string — a runnable one-liner that constructs its OWN probe against the repo's public API at the pinned SHA and exits 0 iff the task-specific behavior is correct). It is AUTHORITATIVE and self-contained so it does not depend on the agent naming a test correctly. working_output.pass = baseline_pass AND assertion_pass. Both are executed with `bash -c` in the cloned repo — never `eval` of an agent/human description.

repos.why_probe: CacheController + BaseCache + adapters. Add-a-backend task subclasses BaseCache — extension is the correct solution.
repos.task_prompt: Add an in-memory LRU cache backend with a max-entries cap by subclassing the existing base cache.
repos.assertion_cmd: printf '%s\n' 'import inspect' 'import cachecontrol.cache as _M, cachecontrol.caches as _C' 'from cachecontrol.cache import BaseCache, DictCache, SeparateBodyBaseCache' 'from cachecontrol.caches import FileCache, SeparateBodyFileCache, RedisCache' '_existing=(BaseCache,DictCache,SeparateBodyBaseCache,FileCache,SeparateBodyFileCache,RedisCache)' '_seen={}' 'for _mod in (_M,_C):' '    for _v in vars(_mod).values():' '        if inspect.isclass(_v) and issubclass(_v,BaseCache) and _v not in _existing:' '            _seen[_v]=True' 'cands=list(_seen)' 'c=None' 'for cls in cands:' '    for kw in ("max_entries","maxsize","max_size","capacity","maxentries"):' '        try:' '            c=cls(**{kw:2}); break' '        except TypeError:' '            c=None' '    if c is None:' '        try:' '            c=cls(2)' '        except TypeError:' '            c=None' '    if c is not None:' '        break' 'assert c is not None, ("no new in-memory LRU BaseCache subclass found; candidates=%r" % [x.__name__ for x in cands])' 'c.set("a",b"1"); c.set("b",b"2")' 'assert c.get("a")==b"1" and c.get("b")==b"2", "get/set broken"' 'c.set("c",b"3")' 'live=[k for k in ("a","b","c") if c.get(k) is not None]' 'assert len(live)<=2, ("cap not enforced; live=%r" % live)' 'assert c.get("c")==b"3", "newest entry evicted"' 'assert c.get("a") is None, ("oldest entry not evicted; live=%r" % live)' 'c.delete("c"); assert c.get("c") is None, "delete broken"' 'print("ok", type(c).__name__, live)' > zz_s6_cc_probe.py && python zz_s6_cc_probe.py ; rc=$?; rm -f zz_s6_cc_probe.py; exit $rc
